Resolves #21317

Adds a single `waitForSelector` for the passthrough iframe (`` `${IFRAME_ID}-passthrough` ``) to the `beforeEach` of `DockSplitterIframePane.spec.mjs`, next to the two existing waits and with the same column alignment. Test-only change: no engine source or product behavior is touched. This closes the race where an arm calls `getComputedStyle(document.getElementById(...))` before the passthrough iframe's DOM is attached, which intermittently failed the `components (1/3)` CI job with `getComputedStyle` receiving `null`.

Evidence: L1 (static: one-line fixture-readiness wait in a spec, `git diff --check`, `check-block-alignment`, `check-parse`, `check-whitespace` all clean) -> L2 required (ticket ACs call for a Playwright spec run; local `node_modules` absent, Playwright not run here).

The AC-2 20× repeat command (`npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.component.mjs test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockSplitterIframePane.spec.mjs --repeat-each=20`) is left to hosted CI. |
